title: باب نِكَاحِ الْمُتْعَةِ وَبَيَانِ أَنَّهُ أُبِيحَ ثُمَّ نُسِخَ ثُمَّ أُبِيحَ ثُمَّ نُسِخَ وَاسْتَقَرَّ تَحْرِيمُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةَ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَبْلَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ سَبْرَةَ الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْمُتْعَةِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ إِنَّهَا حَرَامٌ مِنْ يَوْمِكُمْ هَذَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنْ كَانَ أَعْطَى شَيْئًا فَلاَ يَأْخُذْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me. Hasan ibn Ayan narrated to us. Maqil narrated to us, from Ibn Abi Abla, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz. He said: Rabi ibn Sabrah al-Juhani narrated to us, from his father, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade temporary marriage and said: Indeed, it is forbidden from this day of yours until the Day of Resurrection. Whoever gave anything should not take it back.
translation_de: Salamah ibn Shabib überlieferte mir. Hasan ibn Ayan überlieferte uns. Maqil überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abi Abla, from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz. Er sagte: Rabi ibn Sabrah al-Juhani überlieferte uns, from his father, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) forbade Zeitehe and said: Indeed, it is forbidden from this day of yours until the Day of Resurrection. Whoever gave anything should not take it back. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ أَرْبَعِ نِسْوَةٍ أَنْ يُجْمَعَ بَيْنَهُنَّ الْمَرْأَةِ وَعَمَّتِهَا وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَخَالَتِهَا ‏.‏

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، - قَالَ ابْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ مَدَنِيٌّ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ مِنْ وَلَدِ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ - عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ ذُؤَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ تُنْكَحُ الْعَمَّةُ عَلَى بِنْتِ الأَخِ وَلاَ ابْنَةُ الأُخْتِ عَلَى الْخَالَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd Allah ibn Maslamah ibn Qanab narrated to us. Abd al-Rahman ibn Abd al-Aziz narrated to us. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: A paternal aunt must not be married together with her brother's daughter, nor a brother's daughter together with her maternal aunt.

Ibn Maslamah said: He was a Medinan from the Ansar, descended from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf. He narrated from Ibn Shihab, from Qabisah ibn Dhuayb, from Abu Hurayra. title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَعَمَّتِهَا أَوْ خَالَتِهَا فِي النِّكَاحِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي قَبِيصَةُ بْنُ ذُؤَيْبٍ الْكَعْبِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَجْمَعَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَعَمَّتِهَا وَبَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَخَالَتِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَنُرَى خَالَةَ أَبِيهَا وَعَمَّةَ أَبِيهَا بِتِلْكَ الْمَنْزِلَةِ ‏.‏
translation_en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab. Qabisah ibn Dhuayb al-Kabi informed me that he heard Abu Hurayra say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) forbade a man from combining a woman with her paternal aunt, or a woman with her maternal aunt. Ibn Shihab said: We consider the paternal aunt of her father and the maternal aunt of her father to have the same status.
translation_de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab. Ibn Shihab said: We consider the Tante väterlicherseits of her father and the Tante mütterlicherseits of her father to have the same status. title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الْمَرْأَةِ وَعَمَّتِهَا أَوْ خَالَتِهَا فِي النِّكَاحِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَخْطُبُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ وَلاَ يَسُومُ عَلَى سَوْمِ أَخِيهِ وَلاَ تُنْكَحُ الْمَرْأَةُ عَلَى عَمَّتِهَا وَلاَ عَلَى خَالَتِهَا وَلاَ تَسْأَلُ الْمَرْأَةُ طَلاَقَ أُخْتِهَا لِتَكْتَفِئَ صَحْفَتَهَا وَلْتَنْكِحْ فَإِنَّمَا لَهَا مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: A man must not propose over his brother's proposal, bid over his brother's bid, or marry a woman together with her paternal aunt or maternal aunt. A woman must not ask for her sister's divorce so that she may take her place and empty her dish. Let her marry, for she will have only what Allah has allotted to her.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from Muhammad ibn Sirin, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: A man must not propose over his brother's Heiratsantrag, bid over his brother's bid, or marry a woman together with her Tante väterlicherseits or Tante mütterlicherseits. text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الْمُحْرِمِ وَكَرَاهَةِ خِطْبَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُزَوِّجَ طَلْحَةَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بِنْتَ شَيْبَةَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ : فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى أَبَانَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ يَحْضُرُ ذَلِكَ ، وَهُوَ أَمِيرُ الْحَجِّ ، فَقَالَ أَبَانٌ سَمِعْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَنْكِحُ الْمُحْرِمُ وَلاَ يُنْكَحُ وَلاَ يَخْطُبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Nubayh ibn Wahb. Umar ibn Ubayd Allah wanted to marry Talhah ibn Umar to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr, so he sent for Aban ibn Uthman to attend, while Aban was the commander of the pilgrimage. Aban said: I heard Uthman ibn Affan say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A person in ihram must not marry, be married, or propose marriage.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Nafi, from Nubayh ibn Wahb. Umar ibn Ubayd Allah wanted to marry Talhah ibn Umar to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr, so he sent for Aban ibn Uthman to attend, while Aban was the commander of the pilgrimage. Aban said: I heard Uthman ibn Affan say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A Person im Ihram must not marry, be married, or propose Ehe. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الْمُحْرِمِ وَكَرَاهَةِ خِطْبَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنِي نُبَيْهُ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ وَكَانَ يَخْطُبُ بِنْتَ شَيْبَةَ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَلَى ابْنِهِ فَأَرْسَلَنِي إِلَى أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمَوْسِمِ فَقَالَ أَلاَ أُرَاهُ أَعْرَابِيًّا ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْمُحْرِمَ لاَ يَنْكِحُ وَلاَ يُنْكَحُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَخْبَرَنَا بِذَلِكَ عُثْمَانُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
translation_en: Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Muqaddami narrated to us. Hammad ibn Zayd narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Nafi. Nubayh ibn Wahb narrated to me. He said: Umar ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Mamr sent me while he was proposing to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Uthman for his son. He sent me to Aban ibn Uthman, who was at the pilgrimage site. He said: Am I to see him as a desert Arab? A person in ihram must not marry or be married. Uthman reported this to us from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him).
translation_de: Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Muqaddami überlieferte uns. Hammad ibn Zayd überlieferte uns, from Ayyub, from Nafi. Nubayh ibn Wahb überlieferte mir. Er sagte: Umar ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Mamr sent me while he was proposing to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Uthman for his son. He sent me to Aban ibn Uthman, who was at the pilgrimage site. Er sagte: Am I to see him as a desert Arab? A Person im Ihram must not marry or be married. Uthman reported this to us from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الْمُحْرِمِ وَكَرَاهَةِ خِطْبَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْخَطَّابِ، زِيَادُ بْنُ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَوَاءٍ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ، وَيَعْلَى بْنِ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَنْكِحُ الْمُحْرِمُ وَلاَ يُنْكَحُ وَلاَ يَخْطُبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Ghassan al-Mismai narrated to me. Abd al-Ala narrated to us. Abu al-Khattab Ziyad ibn Yahya narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Sawwa narrated to us. They both said: Sa'id narrated to us, from Matar and Yala ibn Hakim, from Nafi, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman ibn Affan. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A person in ihram must not marry, be married, or propose marriage.
translation_de: Abu Ghassan al-Mismai überlieferte mir. Abd al-Ala überlieferte uns. Abu al-Khattab Ziyad ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Sawwa überlieferte uns. They both said: Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Matar and Yala ibn Hakim, from Nafi, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman ibn Affan. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A Person im Ihram must not marry, be married, or propose Ehe. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الْمُحْرِمِ وَكَرَاهَةِ خِطْبَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ، عُيَيْنَةَ - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْمُحْرِمُ لاَ يَنْكِحُ وَلاَ يَخْطُبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Amr al-Naqid, and Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ayyub ibn Musa, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman, attributing it to the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: A person in ihram must not marry or propose marriage.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Amr al-Naqid, and Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Ayyub ibn Musa, from Nubayh ibn Wahb, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Uthman, attributing it to der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: A Person im Ihram must not marry or propose Ehe. title: باب تَحْرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الْمُحْرِمِ وَكَرَاهَةِ خِطْبَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ نُبَيْهِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ، أَرَادَ أَنْ يُنْكِحَ، ابْنَهُ طَلْحَةَ بِنْتَ شَيْبَةَ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ فِي الْحَجِّ وَأَبَانُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَمِيرُ الْحَاجِّ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى أَبَانٍ إِنِّي قَدْ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُنْكِحَ، طَلْحَةَ بْنَ عُمَرَ فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ تَحْضُرَ، ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبَانٌ أَلاَ أُرَاكَ عِرَاقِيًّا جَافِيًا إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ عَفَّانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَنْكِحُ الْمُحْرِمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuayb ibn al-Layth narrated to us. My father narrated to me, from my grandfather. Khalid ibn Yazid narrated to me. Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal narrated to me, from Nubayh ibn Wahb. Umar ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Mamr wanted to marry his son Talhah to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr during the pilgrimage, while Aban ibn Uthman was commander of the pilgrims. He sent to Aban: I want to marry Talhah ibn Umar, and would like you to attend. Aban said: Do I not see you as a coarse Iraqi? I heard Uthman ibn Affan say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A person in ihram must not marry.
translation_de: Abd al-Malik ibn Shuayb ibn al-Layth überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte mir, from my grandfather. Khalid ibn Yazid überlieferte mir. Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal überlieferte mir, from Nubayh ibn Wahb. Umar ibn Ubayd Allah ibn Mamr wanted to marry his son Talhah to the daughter of Shaybah ibn Jubayr during the pilgrimage, while Aban ibn Uthman was commander of the pilgrims. He sent to Aban: I want to marry Talhah ibn Umar, and would like you to attend. Aban said: Do I not see you as a coarse Iraqi? title: باب تَحْرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الْمُحْرِمِ وَكَرَاهَةِ خِطْبَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، - عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ، عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَزَوَّجَ مَيْمُونَةَ وَهُوَ مُحْرِمٌ ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ الزُّهْرِيَّ فَقَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ الأَصَمِّ أَنَّهُ نَكَحَهَا وَهُوَ حَلاَلٌ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Numayr, and Ishaq al-Hanzali narrated to us, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Ibn Numayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abu al-Shatha. Ibn Abbas informed him that the Prophet (peace be upon him) married Maymunah while he was in ihram. Ibn Numayr added: I told this to al-Zuhri, who said: Yazid ibn al-Asamm informed me that he married her while he was free of ihram.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ibn Numayr, and Ishaq al-Hanzali überlieferte uns, all from Ibn Uyaynah. Ibn Numayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Abu al-Shatha. Ibn Abbas informed him that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) married Maymunah while he was in ihram. Ibn Numayr added: I told this to al-Zuhri, who said: Yazid ibn al-Asamm berichtete mir that he married her while he was free of ihram. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الْمُحْرِمِ وَكَرَاهَةِ خِطْبَتِهِ ‏‏

translation_en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Dawud ibn Abd al-Rahman informed us, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd Abu al-Shatha, from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married Maymunah while he was in ihram.
translation_de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Dawud ibn Abd al-Rahman berichtete uns, from Amr ibn Dinar, from Jabir ibn Zayd Abu al-Shatha, from Ibn Abbas. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married Maymunah while he was in ihram. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ نِكَاحِ الْمُحْرِمِ وَكَرَاهَةِ خِطْبَتِهِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو فَزَارَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، حَدَّثَتْنِي مَيْمُونَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَزَوَّجَهَا وَهُوَ حَلاَلٌ قَالَ وَكَانَتْ خَالَتِي وَخَالَةَ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏
translation_en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Yahya ibn Adam narrated to us. Jarir ibn Hazim narrated to us. Abu Fazarah narrated to us, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm. Maymunah bint al-Harith narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) married her while he was free of ihram. He said: She was my maternal aunt and the maternal aunt of Ibn Abbas.
translation_de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Adam überlieferte uns. Jarir ibn Hazim überlieferte uns. Abu Fazarah überlieferte uns, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm. Maymunah bint al-Harith überlieferte mir that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) married her while he was free of ihram. Er sagte: She was my Tante mütterlicherseits and the Tante mütterlicherseits of Ibn Abbas. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

title: باب تَحْرِيمِ الْخِطْبَةِ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ حَتَّى يَأْذَنَ أَوْ يَتْرُكَ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ وَلاَ يَخْطُبْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Layth narrated to us. Ibn Rumh narrated to us. Al-Layth informed us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: None of you should sell over the sale of another, and none of you should propose over another's proposal.
translation_de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Layth überlieferte uns. Ibn Rumh überlieferte uns. Al-Layth berichtete uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: None of you should sell over the Verkauf of another, and none of you should propose over another's Heiratsantrag. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut bleiben erhalten.

text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانِ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَبِعِ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى بَيْعِ أَخِيهِ وَلاَ يَخْطُبْ عَلَى خِطْبَةِ أَخِيهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
translation_en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me, both from Yahya al-Qattan.
